output.question: What acquisitions has Johnson & Johnson made?
output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, the most recent completed acquisitions I verified are Firefly Bio (July 29, 2026) and Halda Therapeutics (December 29, 2025); J&J also completed Intra-Cellular Therapies in April 2025. Other major recent deals include Shockwave Medical, V-Wave, Ambrx, Laminar and Abiomed, while J&J's heritage timeline records earlier acquisitions including Janssen Pharmaceutica, DePuy, Synthes, Abbott Medical Optics and Momenta Pharmaceuticals. This is a verified selection of completed company acquisitions, not a complete list of every subsidiary, asset or licensing transaction J&J has ever made.

key_facts.fact: Johnson & Johnson completed its acquisition of Firefly Bio, Inc. on July 29, 2026, for $1 billion in cash.
Johnson & Johnson completed its acquisition of Halda Therapeutics OpCo, Inc. on December 29, 2025, for $3.05 billion in cash.
Johnson & Johnson completed its acquisition of Intra-Cellular Therapies, Inc. on April 2, 2025.
Johnson & Johnson completed acquisitions of Shockwave Medical on May 31, 2024, and V-Wave Ltd. on October 9, 2024.
Johnson & Johnson completed its acquisition of Ambrx Biopharma on March 7, 2024; the announced transaction had approximately $2.0 billion of total equity value.
Johnson & Johnson MedTech completed its acquisition of Laminar, Inc. on November 30, 2023, for $400 million upfront plus potential milestone payments.
Johnson & Johnson completed its acquisition of Abiomed, Inc. on December 22, 2022; the transaction's enterprise value was approximately $16.6 billion including cash acquired.
Johnson & Johnson completed the acquisition of Actelion Ltd. on June 16, 2017, for approximately $30 billion in cash.

Johnson & Johnson's heritage timeline records acquisitions of G.F. Merson (1947), Cilag Chemie and McNeil Laboratories (1959), Janssen Pharmaceutica (1963), DePuy (1998), Synthes (2013), Abbott Medical Optics (2018) and Momenta Pharmaceuticals (2020).
